sum: Ten-League International Holdings Limited, through its subsidiaries, engages in the sale of heavy equipment and parts in Singapore and internationally. The company offers foundation equipment, hoist equipment, excavation equipment, and port machinery; value-added engineering solutions; and engineering consultancy services to port, construction, civil engineering, and underground foundation industries. It is also involved in heavy equipment rental; supplying electric reach stacker and empty container handler to port operators, as well as swappable battery pack; and build charging infrastructure. The company was founded in 1998 and is headquartered in Singapore. Ten-League International Holdings Limited operates as a subsidiary of Ten-League Corporations Pte Ltd.
